bank.a: Cha. I-Tengo yi-app yekuhlolwa lelinganisela kutsi imali yakho ihlala sikhatsi lesingakanani. Ayigcini imali, ayibolekisi, ayitsengisi imikhicito futsi ayiniketi seluleko setimali.

data.a: Njengesivakashi, imininingwane yakho ihlala kulebhrawuza elithuluzini lakho futsi kute lokutfunyelwa ku-Tengo. Nobe ngubani lowusebentisa lebhrawuza angayivula, ngako sebentisa kukhiya nge-PIN efonini leyabiwako. I-akhawunti ingekutikhetsela; igcina imininingwane yakho kumhlinzeki welulwati lobalwe esatisweni semfihlo.

cost.a: Lutfo. I-Tengo imahhala ngesikhatsi sekuhlolwa, akudingeki kubhalisa.

wrong.a: Silinganiso lesivela emlandvweni wakho, ngako singase singalungi. Vula Kungani lelilanga kute ubone lokufakiwe, lungisa nobe nguliphi kutsengiselana ku-Imali, noma usebentise Buta ngalomphumela kute ucele kuhlolwa. Kulendemo leso sicelo siyalingiswa futsi sihlala elithuluzini lakho.

picker.deletedBody: Lirisidi {{ref}}, {{date}}. Kususwe kutsengiselana lokuyi-{{count}} kanye nekufakwa kwerekhodi lekuhlola lokuyi-{{audit}}. Khetsa umuntfu kute ucale kabusha.

thabo.situation: Imali yekugibela ngekheshi emalanga lamanyenti kanye nenkokhelo ye-app ngeMsombuluko. Liphetroli nenkokhelo yemoto kuta kucala.

why.title: Kungani lelilanga
why.plain: Sicala ngelibhalansi lakho lalamuhla, sisuse tinkokhelo ngemalanga ato, bese sisebentisa ngelizinga lakho lelijwayelekile lelilanga kuze imali ifike kuziro. Lelo lilanga ngulilanga lakho. Imali longakayitfoli ayibalwa.

rule.enough: Ngisho neliviki lelinzima lihlala kuze kufike imali lelandzelako lengenteka sekwephuze kakhulu.
rule.tight: Liviki lelijwayelekile lihlala kuze kufike imali lelandzelako lejwayelekile. Liviki lelinzima alihlali.
rule.short: Liviki lelijwayelekile liyaphela ngembi kwemali lelandzelako lejwayelekile.
rule.unclear: Umlandvo awenele noma kute imali lengenako, ngako kute lilanga kwanyalo.

me.title: Mine
me.nameBody: I-Tengo isuka egameni lelitsi mutengo, ligama lesiVenda lelisho kubaluleka. Lenchazelo iniketwe ngumsunguli futsi isatawucinisekiswa sikhulumi sesiVenda.

how.1: Yehlukanisa umlandvo wakho ube yimali lengenako, tinkokhelo letijwayelekile nekusebentisa kwemalanga onkhe.
how.2: Ibala kusebentisa kwakho lokujwayelekile kwelilanga kusukela emalangeni la-60 ekugcina, kanye neliviki lelilula neliviki lelinzima.
how.3: Itfola kutsi imali yakho lelandzelako ivame kungena nini nekutsi ivame kuba malini.
how.4: Yehlisa libhalansi lakho lilanga nelilanga, isuse tinkokhelo ngemalanga ato, kuze ifike kuziro. Lelo lilanga ngulilanga lakho.
how.5: Icatsanisa lelo lilanga nemali yakho lelandzelako kute ibeke simo sakho: Yenele, Yenele kancane noma Iyashoda.

plan.notAdvice: Tilinganiso letivela emlandvweni wakho, akusiko seluleko. Kute lapha lokusincumo sekuboleka noma sipho sesikweleti.

money.title: Imali
money.lead: Konkhe kutsengiselana lokusetjentiswa yi-Tengo, netinkokhelo leyitfolile.
money.emptyBodyNone: Kute kutsengiselana kwanyalo. Ngenisa sitatimende kute ucale.
money.billsRule: Inchazelo lefanako nelinani lelifanako, cishe inyanga emkhatsini.
money.importBody: Layisha sitatimende sasebhange se-CSV. Sifundvwa kulelithuluzi futsi sitsatsa indzawo yemlandvo walomuntfu.
money.movableHint: Maka inkokhelo kuphela nangabe ingakhokhwa sekwephuze emalanga lambalwa ngaphandle kwemali yenhlawulo.
money.protectedBill: Ngeke kuphakanyiswe kutsi ihanjiswe: kukhokha sekwephuzile kungabita timali, kuvikelwa noma sikweleti.

import.title: Ngenisa sitatimende
import.lead: Sebentisa sitatimende sasebhange se-CSV kute utsatse indzawo yemlandvo walomuntfu. Ngeke siphume ebhrawuzeni yakho.
import.local: Kucutjungulwa elithuluzini lakho. Kute lokuphuma ebhrawuzeni yakho.
import.formatBody: Lilanga, inchazelo nelinani (lelingaphansi kweziro emalini lephumako), noma emakholomu lahlukene e-debit ne-credit. Emalanga langenani la-14.
import.empty: Khetsa lifayela noma usebentise sitatimende lesisibonelo kute ubone kubuka kucala lapha.
import.mappingHint: Sicagele loku etihlokweni. Shintja nobe nguyiphi lebukeka ingakalungi.
import.needMapping: Khetsa lilanga, inchazelo, kanye nelinani noma emakholomu e-debit ne-credit.
import.skipped_one: Kwecwe umugca lowu-{{count}} ngobe lilanga, inchazelo noma linani akukhonanga kufundvwa.
import.skipped_other: Kwecwe imigca le-{{count}} ngobe lilanga, inchazelo noma linani akukhonanga kufundvwa.
import.tooShort: Lesitatimende sihlanganisa emalanga la-{{count}}. I-Tengo idzinga langenani la-14.
import.wideRange: Emalanga la-{{count}} kuphela emlandvo. Sibikelo sitawusebenta, kodvwa libanga litawuba libanti.
import.shifted_one: Emalanga ahanjiswe embili ngelilanga lelili-{{count}} kute sitatimende siphele itolo.
import.shifted_other: Emalanga ahanjiswe embili ngemalanga la-{{count}} kute sitatimende siphele itolo.
import.balanceFromFile: Litsetfwe kulibhalansi lekugcina efayeleni: {{amount}}. Bhala kute ulishintje.
import.balanceKept: Kute likholomu lelibhalansi. Kugcinwa libhalansi lanyalo la-{{amount}}. Bhala kute ulishintje.
import.confirm: Faka umlandvo lomusha bese ubona lilanga lami
import.replaceNote: Loku kutsatsa indzawo yemlandvo walomuntfu kulelithuluzi futsi kufaka lokufakiwe erekhodini lekuhlola.
import.tooBig: Lelofayela likhulu kune-2 MB, lokungetulu kwaloko sitatimende lesikudzingako. Khetsa sikhatsi lesifushane noma lifayela lelincane.

edit.title: Hlela kutsengiselana
edit.auditNote: Kugcina kufaka lokufakiwe erekhodini lakho lekuhlola.
edit.oneOffHint: Kushiywe ngaphandle kweliphetfo lakho lelijwayelekile lekusebentisa nemali lengenako. Kusabalwa kulibhalansi lakho.

audit.bill_answered: Kuphendvulwe umbuto mayelana nenkokhelo lebebukeka ingakakhokhelwa
audit.plan_settings: Kushintjwe kusebentisa lokungancishiswa noma tinkokhelo letingahanjiswa

inbox.title: Imilayeto
inbox.offBody: Uvale imilayeto yamalanga onkhe, ngako kute lokungabukwa kucala. Yivule lapha noma ku-Imfihlo.

facts.what: Lilanga lakho, simo nesabelomali selilanga kuphela.
facts.never: Ngeke kube ngulibhalansi lakho noma kutsengiselana kwakho.
facts.stop: Umlayeto ngamunye usho kutsi uvela ku-Tengo nekutsi ungayimisa njani. Ungavala imilayeto futsi ku-Imfihlo.
facts.where: Imilayeto ye-WhatsApp beyitawudlula ku-Meta, ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika. I-SMS ngulenye indlela. Kuyalingiswa lapha: kute lokutfunyelwako.

whatsapp.enough: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kube nga-*{{date}}*. Simo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.tight: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kube nga-*{{date}}* ngeliviki lelijwayelekile. Simo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_one: Imali yakho ingase iphele nga-*{{date}}*, lilanga lelili-{{count}} ngembi kwemali yakho lelandzelako. Simo: {{state}}.
whatsapp.short_other: Imali yakho ingase iphele nga-*{{date}}*, emalanga la-{{count}} ngembi kwemali yakho lelandzelako. Simo: {{state}}.

tip.tight: Gcina kusebentisa kwakho eduze nesabelomali sakho selilanga kuze kufike imali yakho lelandzelako.
tip.short: Buka Hlela ku-Tengo kute ubone lokusita kakhulu.

whatsapp.stsNotAdvised: Sabelomali selilanga: akunconywa kuze kufike imali yakho lelandzelako.
whatsapp.unclear: I-Tengo ayikabi nalokwenele kukunika lilanga. Vula i-Tengo kute ubone kutsi yini lokufanele uyifake.
whatsapp.stsPending: Sabelomali selilanga: sitawubalwa nangabe inkokhelo yalamuhla isingenile.
whatsapp.stop: Kuvela ku-Tengo. Phendvula nge-STOP kute umise letibuyeketo.
whatsapp.discreet: Tengo: sibuyeketo sakho selilanga silungile. Vula i-app kute usibone.
whatsapp.noNextDaily: Imali ingena emalanga lamanyenti, ngako kute inkokhelo yinye lelandzelako.

sms.tight: Tengo: Sawubona {{name}}, imali ihlala kuze kube nga-{{date}} ngeliviki lelijwayelekile ({{state}}). Sabelomali {{sts}} ngelilanga.

help.title: Lokusita kakhulu
help.moveBill: Nangabe i-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ingakhokhwa emva kwa-{{date}} ngaphandle kwemali yenhlawulo, loko kuphela kufinyelela ku-{{state}}.
help.setAside: Ungabeka eceleni kuze kufike ku-{{amount}} lamuhla futsi usahlala ku-Yenele kuze kufike imali yakho lelandzelako. Lesi sikhala lesifanako nesitsi Sikhala sekuboleka, hhayi lesengetiwe.
help.coveredBody: Imali yakho kufanele ihlale kuze kufike imali yakho lelandzelako, ngisho neliviki lelinzima kakhulu.
help.earn: Tfola noma wemukele {{amount}} lowengetiwe ngembi kwa-{{date}}, sibonelo umsebenti lowengetiwe noma imali lokweletwa yona.
help.earnAssume: Kucatjangwa kutsi kusebentisa kwakho kuhlala njengalokujwayelekile. Kuboleka kute uvale ligebe kuvame kubita kakhulu kamuva.
help.trim: Sebentisa cishe {{amount}} ngelilanga ngaphansi ku-{{groups}} kuze kube nga-{{date}}.
help.trimAssume: Kusebentisa kuphela lokumake njengalokungancishiswa. Kucatjangwa kutsi konkhe lokunye kuhlala njengalokujwayelekile.
help.trimPartial: Loko kusebentisa konkhe lokumake njengalokungancishiswa, ngako kuvala ingcenye yeligebe. Lokusele kusadzinga imali lengenako.
help.moveAssume: Uyimake njengalengahanjiswa. Buta kucala. Ungaweci ema-debit order etikweleti noma emshwalense.
help.markFlexible: Maka kusebentisa kwemalanga onkhe lokungancishiswa kute ubone lapho ungasika khona.
help.freeHelp: Nangabe usalele emuva etikweletini, i-National Credit Regulator ibala lusito lwamahhala:
help.ideasNote: Imibono, akusiko seluleko. Hlola timali netinhlawulo ngembi kwekushintja inkokhelo.

spending.title: Lapho imali yemalanga onkhe iya khona
spending.empty: Kute kusebentisa kwemalanga onkhe emalangeni la-30 ekugcina.
spending.flexibleHint: Maka kusebentisa longakunciphisa nangabe imali ishoda. Tindleko temsebenti letifana nesituki neliphetroli ngeke tiphakanyiswe kutsi tinciphiswe.

palette.title: Imenyu yemiyalo
palette.placeholder: Ya ekhasini, shintja umuntfu, shintja lulwimi
palette.help: Tinkinobho temicibisholo kute uhambe, Enter kute ukhetse, Esc kute uvale.

overdrawn.title: Ukweleta nga-{{amount}} ebhange
overdrawn.body: Imali lengenako ikhokha loku kucala. Lilanga lakho libalwa kusukela lapho libhalansi selingetulu kwa-R0 futsi.

asOf.title: Kusukela esitatimendeni sakho
asOf.body_one: Lesibikelo sivela esitatimendeni sakho, lesiphela nga-{{date}}, lilanga lelili-{{count}} leledlule. Faka libhalansi lalamuhla kute usibuyeketa.
asOf.body_other: Lesibikelo sivela esitatimendeni sakho, lesiphela nga-{{date}}, emalanga la-{{count}} ledlule. Faka libhalansi lalamuhla kute usibuyeketa.

historyEnds.title: Umlandvo uphela nga-{{date}}
historyEnds.body: Kusebentisa kusukela ngalesosikhatsi akukho emlandvweni wakho, ngako sibikelo sisebentisa liphetfo kuze kube ngulelo lilanga nelibhalansi lalamuhla.

paused.title: Imali lengenako ibukeka imisiwe
paused.body: Kute lokufana netinkokhelo takho letijwayelekile lokungenile kusukela nga-{{date}}. I-Tengo ayisatsembi imali lelandzelako futsi esikhundleni saloko ihlola emalanga la-30 letako.

notice.pausedNoDate: Kute lokufana netinkokhelo takho letijwayelekile lokungenile sikhatsi lesitsite. I-Tengo ayisatsembi imali lelandzelako futsi esikhundleni saloko ihlola emalanga la-30 letako.

irregular.title: Kute liphetfo lelijwayelekile kwanyalo
irregular.body: Imali iyangena, kodvwa hhayi ngesigci i-Tengo lengasisebentisa. Ihlola emalanga la-30 letako esikhundleni selilanga lemali lelandzelako.

pendingToday.title: Inkokhelo ifanele lamuhla
pendingToday.body: Inkokhelo yakho lejwayelekile ifanele lamuhla futsi ayikangeni kulibhalansi lakho, ngako isabalwa njengaletako.

missedBill.title: I-{{name}} ({{amount}}) ibukeka ingakakhokhwa
missedBill.body: Bekufanele cishe nga-{{date}} futsi ayikabonakali. Tjela i-Tengo kutsi kwentekeni kute lilanga lihlale lilungile.

oneOffs.body_one: Imali lenkhulu leyenteka kanye le-{{count}} ishiywe ngaphandle kwekusebentisa nemali lengenako lejwayelekile.
oneOffs.body_other: Timali letinkhulu letenteka kanye leti-{{count}} tishiywe ngaphandle kwekusebentisa nemali lengenako lejwayelekile.

notice.label: Tintfo lokufanele utihlole

askOneOff.title: Ingabe i-{{name}} ({{amount}}, {{date}}) beyintfo leyenteka kanye?
askOneOff.body: Inkhulu kakhulu kunekusebentisa kwakho lokujwayelekile, futsi ngemlandvo lomfisha i-Tengo ayikhoni kusho. Kwanyalo ibalwa njengekusebentisa lokujwayelekile.

estimated.title: Kulinganiselwe etimphendvulweni takho
estimated.body: Ingcenye yemlandvo wakho ivela emibutweni yekusetha, ngako kucinisekisa kuphansi. Lokufakiwe kwangempela, likheshi lolifaka lapha noma sitatimende kutsatsa indzawo yesilinganiso.

sample.title: Tinombolo letitibonelo
sample.body: Lesibikelo sisebentisa tinombolo letitibonelo, hhayi takho. Tishintje ku-Imali, noma utitsatsele indzawo ngesitatimende noma ngetimphendvulo takho.

quota.title: Ayikhonanga kugcina kulelithuluzi
quota.body: Sitoreji salebhrawuza sigcwele, ngako lushintjo lwakho lwekugcina alugcinwanga. Khipha imininingwane yakho, bese ukhulula sikhala noma ususe imininingwane lendzala.

unavailable.title: Ayikhonanga kugcina kulelithuluzi
unavailable.body: Lebhrawuza ivimba sitoreji, sibonelo efasitelweni leliyimfihlo, ngako lushintjo lwakho lwekugcina alugcinwanga.

corrupt.title: Imininingwane yakho legciniwe ayikhonanga kufundvwa
corrupt.body: Kukhona lokungakahambi kahle ngemininingwane legcinwe kulebhrawuza. Ikhophi igcinwe kulelithuluzi. Cala kabusha kute uchubeke usebentisa i-Tengo.

hints.in: Likheshi lolitfolile, sibonelo imali yekugibela, likhasimende noma imali lebuyiswe ngumndeni. Libalwa njengemali lengenako.
hints.hand: Likheshi lonalo nyalo. Loku kusetha libhalansi lelikheshi futsi akufaki lokufakiwe.

accounts.title: Lapho imali yakho ikhona
accounts.lead: Sibikelo sakho sisebentisa sibalo sako konkhe loku.
accounts.name: Libito

obligations.title: Lenye imali loyikweletako
obligations.lead: Stokvel, umasingcwabisane, kusekela umndeni netikweleti letingekho emtsetfweni. Kubalwa njengetinkokhelo.
obligations.name: Libito
obligations.movableHint: Kuphela nangabe ingakhokhwa sekwephuze emalanga lambalwa ngaphandle kwenkinga.
obligations.protected: Ngeke kuphakanyiswe kutsi kuhanjiswe: kukhokha sikweleti noma umasingcwabisane sekwephuzile kungakubita.

setup.title: Setha ngesandla
setup.lead: Awunaso sitatimende? Phendvula imibuto lembalwa bese i-Tengo ilinganisela umlandvo wekucala. Lokufakiwe kwangempela kutsatsa indzawo yawo njengoba ukufaka.
setup.pretend: Ungasebentisa tinombolo tekutentisa kute ukuzame. Kute lokuphuma kulelithuluzi.
setup.arrives: Indlela imali yakho levame kungena ngayo

arrivalHint.daily: Sibonelo imali yekugibela ngekheshi noma kutsengisa emalanga lamanyenti.
arrivalHint.weekly: Sibonelo inkokhelo yeliviki noma imali yaMgcibelo.
arrivalHint.irregular: Sibonelo imali lefakwako cishe njalo ngeliviki, kodvwa hhayi ngelilanga lelincunyiwe.

setup.dailySpendHint: Kudla, kutfutfa, i-airtime nalokunye lokunjalo. Hhayi irenti noma letinye tinkokhelo.
setup.billsHint: Irenti, inkontileka yelucingo, imali yesikolwa naletinye tinkokhelo letikhokhwa njalo ngenyanga.
setup.billError: Inkokhelo ngayinye idzinga libito, linani lelingetulu kweziro nelilanga lelisuka ku-1 kuya ku-31.
setup.estimatedNote: I-Tengo yenta umlandvo wekucala kusukela kuletimphendvulo, umakwe njengalolinganiselwe. Kucinisekisa kuhlala kuphansi kuze kufike lokufakiwe kwangempela.

safetyPolicy.title: Kuphepha nekutsi i-Tengo ngeyabani
safetyPolicy.lead: Indlela i-Tengo levikela ngayo bantfu labasebentisa tifoni letabiwako, bantfu labasengotini nebantfwana.
safetyPolicy.draft: Inchubomgomo luhlaka yekuhlolwa, letawubuyeketwa ngummeli nemeluleki wekuvikela.

adults.title: Bantfu labadzala kuphela
adults.body: I-Tengo ngeyebantfu labadzala. Nangabe uneminyaka lengaphansi kwa-18, siyacela ungayisebentisi. Kugcina ku-akhawunti kukucela kutsi ucinisekise kutsi uneminyaka la-18 noma ngetulu. I-Tengo ayiceli lilanga lekutalwa noma inombolo yemazisi, futsi bantfu labacanjiwe bedemo bantfu labadzala.

shared.title: Tifoni letabiwako
shared.body: Ungasetha i-PIN kute i-Tengo itikhiye emva kwemizuzu lembalwa, uvule indlela yekufihla kute timali tihlale tifihliwe uze uticindzetele kute utibone, futsi usebentise kuphuma ngekushesha kute ushiye i-Tengo uye ekhasini lelingenalutfo ngaso leso sikhatsi. Imilayeto lefihliwe ayinato timali, emalanga noma emagama esimo.

control.title: Nangabe umuntfu aphetse imali yakho
control.body: Kute umuntfu lokufanele akuphocelele kutsi ukhombise sibikelo sakho, wabelane nge-PIN yakho noma unikete imali yakho. I-Tengo ngeke ikucele ligama leliyimfihlo lasebhange noma i-PIN. Nangabe umuntfu ahlola ifoni yakho, kuphuma ngekushesha nekukhiya nge-PIN kuyasita, futsi ungasusa imininingwane yakho nobe nini ku-Imfihlo.

care.title: Kunakekela bantfu labasesimeni lesimatima
care.body: I-Tengo isebentisa emagama lalula, ikhombisa tilinganiso hhayi teluleko, futsi ngeke iphakamise kuboleka, kweca inkokhelo yesikweleti noma yemshwalense, noma kunciphisa situkhi sebhizinisi. Nangabe imali ibukeka ishoda, ikhomba lusito lwamahhala lolusuka ku-National Credit Regulator.

never.title: Loko i-Tengo lengeke ikwente
never.body: I-Tengo ayenti tincumo tekuboleka noma tesikweleti, ayitsengisi imikhicito, futsi ayabelani ngemininingwane yakho nanobe ngubani ngekukhangisa. Kute lokumayelana nesibikelo sakho lokusetjentiselwa kukwehlulela.

help.title: Nangabe udzinga lusito nyalo
help.gbv: I-Gender-Based Violence Command Centre: 0800 428 428, mahhala futsi ivulekile emini nebusuku.
help.childline: I-Childline, yebantfwana nanobe ngubani lokhatsatekile ngemntfwana: 116, mahhala.
help.note: Tinombolo titawucinisekiswa ngembi kwekwetfulwa. I-Tengo akusilo lusito lwetimo letiphutfumako.

lock.title: I-Tengo ikhiyiwe
lock.lead: Faka i-PIN yakho kute uvule i-Tengo.
lock.wait: Imizamo minyenti kakhulu. Lindza kancane bese uzama futsi.
lock.waitFor_one: Imizamo minyenti kakhulu. Zama futsi emva kwemzuzwana lowu-{{count}}.
lock.waitFor_other: Imizamo minyenti kakhulu. Zama futsi emva kwemizuzwana le-{{count}}.
lock.forgotBody: I-Tengo ayikhoni kubuyisa i-PIN, ngobe ngeke igcinwe. Kute ucale kabusha, susa yonkhe imininingwane ye-Tengo kulelithuluzi. Loku ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva.

shared.title: Kuphepha kwefoni leyabiwako
shared.lockOff: Kuvaliwe. Setha i-PIN yetinombolo leti-4 kuya kuleti-6 kute ukhiye i-Tengo nangabe ungekho.
shared.lockOn: Kuvuliwe. I-Tengo iyatikhiya emva kwemizuzu le-{{count}} ingasetjentiswa.
shared.pinHint: Tinombolo leti-4 kuya kuleti-6. Igcinwa kuphela njengekhodi lehlanganisiwe kulelithuluzi futsi ngeke ibuyiswe.
shared.discreetHint: Fihla timali esikrinini uze ucindzetele Khombisa timali, futsi utfumele imilayeto lengenato timali noma emalanga.
shared.quickExitHint: Kuphuma ngekushesha kuhlala kungetulu esikrinini. Kufihla konkhe futsi kuvule likhasi lelingenalutfo.

diag.title: Kuhlola emaphutsa
diag.lead: Kwelusito ngenkinga. Kute imininingwane yemuntfu legcinwa lapha, futsi kute lokutfunyelwako.

own.cardPromise: Tinombolo takho, lilanga lakho. Kute lokuphuma elithuluzini lakho ngaphandle kwekutsi ugcina i-akhawunti.
own.cardBody: Ngenisa sitatimende, phendvula imibuto lembalwa, noma uzame kucala ngetinombolo letitibonelo. Akudzingeki kubhalisa.

welcome.title: Sebentisa imali yakho
welcome.nicknameHint: Lisetjentiselwa kukubingelela kuphela. Lishiye lingenalutfo nangabe utsandza.

s1.title: Loko i-Tengo lekucelako, nekutsi kungani
s1.lead: I-Tengo ibala kutsi imali yakho ihlala sikhatsi lesingakanani nekutsi imali yakho lelandzelako ivame kungena nini. Idzinga lokuncane kuphela kute ikwente loko.

money.title: Imali yakho lengenako nalephumako
money.body: Emalanga, timali netinchazelo letifushane, kanye nelibhalansi lakho. Kusukela esitatimendeni, etimphendvulweni letimbalwa, noma etinombolweni letitibonelo.

bills.title: Tinkokhelo letijwayelekile nemali loyikweletako
bills.body: Tintfo letifana nerenti, inkontileka yelucingo noma i-stokvel, kute i-Tengo ikhone kutigcinela imali.

never.title: Ngeke
never.body: I-Tengo ngeke icele inombolo yemazisi, inombolo yelucingo, kungena ebhange noma i-PIN.

where.title: Lapho kuhlala khona
where.body: Kulelithuluzi kuphela, ngaphandle kwekutsi kamuva ukhetse kukugcina ku-akhawunti. Ungakususa nobe nini.

s2.title: Kukhetsa kwakho
s2.lead: Sibikelo kuphela lesidzingekako. Konkhe lokunye kuvaliwe uze ukuvule.
s2.core: Kuyadzingeka kute kubalwe lilanga lakho. Kusebenta kulelithuluzi. Hocisa nobe nini bese kuyama.
s2.notice: Satiso lesiphelele semfihlo sisho lokugcinwako, lapho, sikhatsi lesingakanani, nekutsi ungakhalata njani.

s3.title: Faka imali yakho
s3.lead: Khetsa indlela yinye. Ungayishintja noma uyitsatsele indzawo kamuva ku-Imali.
s3.importBody: Lifayela le-CSV lelivela ebhange lakho. Lifundvwa kulelithuluzi.
s3.manualBody: Nangabe ungenaso sitatimende. I-Tengo ilinganisela umlandvo wekucala kusukela etimphendvulweni takho.
s3.sampleBody: Hlola ngaphandle kwekubhala lutfo. Sibonelo simakiwe futsi ungashintja yonkhe inombolo.

s4.lead: Lesi silinganiso lesivela etinombolweni lotinikile, akusiso seluleko. Siba ncono njengoba ufaka lokufakiwe kwangempela.
s4.sample: Leti tinombolo letitibonelo, hhayi takho. Tishintje ku-Imali, noma utitsatsele indzawo ngesitatimende noma ngetimphendvulo takho.

legalDoc.draft: Luhlaka lwekuhlolwa, lolutawubuyeketwa ngummeli ngembi kwekwetfulwa. I-Tengo akusilo libhange futsi ayiniketi seluleko setimali. Lesatiso asisho kutsi silandzela nobe nguwuphi umtsetfo noma sitifiketi.
legalDoc.placeholderWarning: Licembu leliphetse neSikhulu Selwati abakabitwa. Kufanele bagcwaliswe ngembi kwekwetfulwa kwangempela.

what.title: Loko i-Tengo lekugcinako
what.body: Umlandvo wemali lowufakako (emalanga, timali, tinchazelo letifushane netigaba), emabhalansi akho, tinkokhelo letijwayelekile nemali loyikweletako, kukhetsa kwakho netilungiselelo, sibongo longasikhetsa, kanye nelirekhodi laloko lokwentile ku-app. Nangabe ugcina i-akhawunti, nelikheli lakho le-imeyili. I-Tengo ayiceli futsi ayigcini tinombolo temazisi, tinombolo telucingo, kungena ebhange noma ema-PIN. Tinombolo letindze etinchazelweni letingenisiwe tiyafihlwa.

why.title: Kungani
why.body: Kuphela kubala kutsi imali yakho ihlala sikhatsi lesingakanani, imali yakho lelandzelako ivame kungena nini, netilinganiso letisesikrinini. Hhayi ngekukhangisa, kulinganisa sikweleti, tincumo tekuboleka noma kutsengisela nobe ngubani. Kuniketa imininingwane kungekutitsandzela; ngaphandle kwayo kute sibikelo.

where.title: Lapho kucutjungulwa khona
where.body:
Njengesivakashi, konkhe kuhlala kulebhrawuza kulelithuluzi futsi sibikelo sibalwa elithuluzini. Kute lokutfunyelwa ku-Tengo.
Nangabe ukhetsa kugcina i-akhawunti, imininingwane yakho igcinwa kumhlinzeki welulwati lobalwe ekusetheni (Supabase), esifundzeni lesikhetfwe ngumsebentisi, futsi itfunyelwa ngekuchumana lokuvikelekile. Sibikelo sisabalwa elithuluzini lakho. Nobe nguliphi kugcina ngaphandle kweNingizimu Afrika kudzinga kuvikelwa lokwenele ngaphansi kwesigaba 72 se-POPIA futsi kutawubalwa lapha ngembi kwekwetfulwa.

who.title: Ngubani longakubona
who.body: Njengesivakashi: nobe ngubani lowusebentisa lebhrawuza kulelithuluzi. Sebentisa kukhiya nge-PIN efonini leyabiwako. Nge-akhawunti: wena, emva kwekungena. Imigca yemuntfu ngamunye ikhiyelwe kuye elulwatini. Kute kufinyelela kwetisebenti emigceni yakho lokusetjwe. Nangabe kusekela kwake kukudzinga, lesatiso sitawucala sisho kutsi kukhawulelwa futsi kurekhodwa njani.

keep.title: Kugcinwa sikhatsi lesingakanani
keep.body: Kutsengiselana lokungetulu kwetinyanga leti-12 kuyasuswa kulelithuluzi nangabe i-Tengo ivuleka. Ku-akhawunti, umsebenti weseva wekukususa ubhaliwe kodvwa awukavulwa. Ungasusa konkhe nobe nini; ku-akhawunti, kususa kususa imigca yakho nekungena kwakho, futsi utfola lirisidi lelingenayo imininingwane yemuntfu. Emakhophi ekulondvoloza lagcinwa ngumhlinzeki wekusingatsa asuswa ngekwehlelo lawo, lelitawubalwa lapha ngembi kwekwetfulwa.

rights.title: Emalungelo akho
rights.body: Ungabona imininingwane yakho futsi uyikhiphe njenge-JSON noma i-CSV, ulungise nobe nguliphi lokufakiwe, ucele umuntfu kutsi ahlole umphumela, uhocise nobe nguliphi kukhetsa, futsi ususe konkhe. Ungakhalata kulicembu leliphetse lelingenhla, nakuMlawuli Welwati waseNingizimu Afrika.

not.title: Loko i-Tengo lengesiko
not.body: I-Tengo kuhlolwa. Akusilo libhange, akusiyo inhlangano leniketa tikweleti futsi akusuye umeluleki wetimali. Tinombolo tayo tilinganiso letivela emlandvweni wakho, futsi ayenti tincumo ngawe.

changes.title: Tinguculo
changes.body: Nangabe lesatiso sishintja, inguculo lengenhla iyashintja futsi i-Tengo ikucela kutsi usibuke futsi ngembi kwekutsi uchubeke.

use.title: Kusebentisa i-Tengo
use.body: I-Tengo imahhala kuyisebentisa ngesikhatsi sekuhlolwa. Ngeyebantfu labadzala, labaneminyaka la-18 noma ngetulu. Yisebentise kuphela ngemali yakho noma ngetinombolo tekutentisa.

estimate.title: Tilinganiso, hhayi tetsembiso
estimate.body: Onkhe lilanga, sabelomali nesiphakamiso silinganiso lesivela emaphetfweni langaphambilini. Imali ingangena sekwephuzile noma ingangeni nhlobo, futsi tinkokhelo tingashintja. Hlola ngembi kwekwenta sincumo lesibalulekile.

liability.title: Tincumo takho
liability.body: I-Tengo ayiniketi seluleko setimali futsi ayinasibopho ngetincumo lotentako uyisebentisa. Kute lapha lokukhawulela emalungelo lonawo ngaphansi kwemtsetfo waseNingizimu Afrika.

accounts.title: Ema-akhawunti
accounts.body: Ema-akhawunti angekutikhetsela. Gcina kufinyelela elikhelini lakho le-imeyili, ngobe kungena kwentiwa ngekhodi yesikhatsi sinye. Ungaphuma yonkhe indzawo futsi ususe i-akhawunti yakho nobe nini.

ending.title: Kuphela kwekuhlolwa
ending.body: Nangabe kuhlolwa kuyaphela, utawutjelwa ku-app futsi unikwe sikhatsi sekukhipha imininingwane yakho ngembi kwekutsi isuswe.

complaints.title: Tikhalo
complaints.body: Chumana nelicembu leliphetse lelingenhla. Ngetikhalo temfihlo ungaya futsi kuMlawuli Welwati waseNingizimu Afrika.

account.title: I-akhawunti
account.unavailable: Ema-akhawunti akasetjwanga kulelikhophi ye-Tengo. Iphrofayili yakho ihlala kulelithuluzi.
account.lead: Gcina ku-akhawunti kute ukugcine kunobe nguliphi lithuluzi. Kungekutikhetsela: i-Tengo isebenta ngalokuphelele ngaphandle kwayo.
account.leadSaved: Iphrofayili yakho igcinwe ku-akhawunti yakho. Sibikelo sakho sisabalwa kulelithuluzi.

facts.passwordless: Kute ligama leliyimfihlo: ungena ngekhodi yesikhatsi sinye letfunyelwa ku-imeyili yakho.
facts.device: Sibikelo sakho sisabalwa elithuluzini lakho. I-akhawunti igcina imininingwane yakho kuphela.
facts.where: Kugcinwe kumhlinzeki welulwati lobalwe esatisweni semfihlo. Nguwe kuphela longafundza imigca yakho.
facts.leave: Phuma yonkhe indzawo, khipha noma ususe konkhe nobe nini.

account.conflictLead: Lelithuluzi nalo linephrofayili. Ngalokuvamile ugcina imininingwane ye-akhawunti. Ungayitsatsela indzawo ngemininingwane yalelithuluzi esikhundleni saloko.
account.replaceWarn: Kutsatsela indzawo kususa loko i-akhawunti lenako nyalo futsi ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva.

account.deleteBody: Kususa yonkhe imigca iseva lenayo ngawe nekungena kwakho, futsi ikunike lirisidi lelingenayo imininingwane yemuntfu. Emakhophi ekulondvoloza lagcinwa ngumhlinzeki wekusingatsa aphelelwa sikhatsi ngekwehlelo lakhe, lelibalwe esatisweni semfihlo.
account.deleteWarn: Loku ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva. Khipha kucala nangabe ufuna ikhophi.

errors.rate_limited: Ikhodi itfunyelwe sikhashana lesendlulile. Lindza umzuzu, bese uzama futsi.

errors.generic: Kukhona lokungakahambi kahle. Hlola kuchumana kwakho bese uzama futsi.
